Package com.ds.googol.model

Class WebClient

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
com.ds.googol.model.WebClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Remote, RMIClientsInterface
public class WebClient extends UnicastRemoteObject implements RMIClientsInterface
The WebClient class represents a client in the distributed system. It implements the RMIClientsInterface to support RMI communication.
